observations: Entity-own-operable: 479 forwarding-only nodes plus their 479 input OR connectors hold 328 stored pebbles and 552 represented contexts in split matching. The other 250 nodes hold 6457 stored pebbles and must keep their space/bootstrap alternatives.

Recipe-unlock: 88 multi-input technology-only forwarding nodes plus their 88 input OR connectors hold 4554 stored pebbles and 9152 represented contexts in split matching. Eight further forwarding nodes have empty technology ORs and no pebbles; removing a forwarder must retain the empty OR as a lock.

All audited forwarding nodes have exactly the same represented context set as their source in each measured stage. This is baseline observational evidence, not proof of equivalence after changing topology or scheduling.
The initial reduced logic has 52 multi-input recipe unlock groups; after planetary changes/expansion the matching graph has 88. Counts from those stages must not be conflated.
Existing single-technology contraction already removes both recipe unlock nodes where eligible. The remaining opportunity is sharing recipe-unlock with its existing recipe-tech-unlock OR.

entity-own-operable: Redirect only identity input cases; retain downstream ability changes, amounts and used_payback. Keep alternative-bearing nodes explicit.
Provide reversible expansion and include it in reduction-check/superposition; reductions expanded for planetary debt otherwise return before matching.
Update explorer root filtering and skipped-row behavior for ownership standing in for operable ownership.
recipe-unlock: Preserve the recipe-tech-unlock OR and every alternative. Keep fixed-machine alternatives explicit.

Preserve the claiming boundary: removing recipe-unlock exposes recipe-tech-unlock -> recipe, which recipe-tech-unlocks.claim recognizes. Do not accidentally activate that handler on previously unclaimed edges, especially empty ORs.
Extend unlock expansion/query handling for partially contracted groups; current expand returns immediately when recipe-tech-unlock already exists.

Preserve capability pricing: the removed OR input has no consumed amount. The live audit now rejects consuming downstream outputs as well; that additional guard was added after this frozen probe and has unit coverage.
Validate restored topology, costs, surviving contexts, claiming/customization, debt/promotion and both final audits before integrating.

recommendation: Prioritize recipe-unlock by stored pebbles; entity-own-operable is a small secondary cleanup. First design reversible sharing that preserves claiming and debt identities.
